name: indiamart-b2b-supplier-scraper
title: IndiaMART Product & Supplier Scraper
description: Extract public IndiaMART product and supplier listing data for sourcing and market research: company, product, city, price, MOQ, ratings, verification badges, images, specifications, and source URLs. No phone numbers or emails.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).

supplier-scraped.eventDescription: Charged once for each clean IndiaMART product and supplier record saved atomically to the dataset.
